summary: Executed targeted backend + mobile-web frontend regression for primitive text-to-CAD and 3D viewer fixes. Verified block/cylinder primitive API outputs, auth screen stability, canvas AI generation integration, and viewer rendering with depth=20 on generated and direct seeded routes.

issues: Top icon button touch targets appear ~40x40 (padding 8 around 24px icon), slightly below recommended 44x44 mobile minimum

action_items: Optional: add testID attributes to interactive cards/buttons in /app/frontend/app/home.tsx to improve regression automation reliability.
Optional UX polish: increase viewer3d top icon touch target size to >=44x44 points.
critical_code_review_comments: Interactive controls in /app/frontend/app/home.tsx currently lack testID attributes, which violates mobile automation guideline expectations and makes stable E2E selection harder.
viewer3d render loop uses requestAnimationFrame without explicit teardown; consider cleanup on unmount to avoid potential GL loop leaks across route transitions.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data created. Guest-mode and direct endpoint tests only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression scope validated for primitive text-to-CAD and 3D viewer flow. If future viewer regressions appear, first verify elementsData presence in URL and depth normalization before GL rendering checks.
rca_of_issue: One initial Playwright failure was test-script related (generate button outside viewport in modal on 375x667). Resolved by scrolling element into view before click; application flow then passed.
